subject: Deletion gating & rollback playbook — bespoke retention windows
messages:
From: Alex Nguyen <alex.nguyen@heliopharm.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: Sora Tech <security@soratech.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Questions on bespoke retention windows and deletion gating

Vanessa — thanks for the walkthrough yesterday. A couple of follow-ups from our Security and Ops teams: 

1) We need firm language for the order form that spells out the deletion gating conditions (e.g., escrow hold, legal hold, export window) and who has the authority to trigger/clear the hold. Can Redwood provide a standard gating matrix we can include as an appendix?

2) If we request an accelerated wipe (customer-initiated), what are the SLAs for complete deletion from hot storage, across caches, and then from backups/archival tiers? We need timelines that map to our change control windows.

3) For rollback/restore scenarios (e.g., accidental purge during an export), do you offer a documented rollback playbook and is that a billable professional service or included with Dedicated/Private plans?

Can you share a draft we can review alongside our legal team's redlines?

—Alex
Director of Cloud Ops, Helio Pharmaceuticals

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Nguyen <alex.nguyen@heliopharm.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai, Sora Tech <security@soratech.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Questions on bespoke retention windows and deletion gating

Alex — thanks, great questions. Attached is a working draft of a "Deletion Gating & Rollback Playbook" plus a short diff file for proposed order form language. High level answers below; details in the PDF: 

- Gating matrix: we include explicit triggers (legal hold, incident response hold, export window > 48 hrs, regulatory subpoena) and roles (Customer Security Admin, Redwood Trust Admin). The appendix maps each trigger to required evidence and an expected maximum clearance SLA (typically 24–72 hrs depending on type).

- Deletion timelines: standard hosted API customers see hot-storage wipe within 24 hrs, KV/prefix caches invalidated within 6 hrs, and archival retention subject to backup retention cadence (we specify max 90 days for our default archival; bespoke order forms can reduce that to as low as 7 days with a different commit). For Dedicated/Private we can contract specific pass windows and provide deletion certification. The draft proposes:
  * Hot storage token deletion: 24 hrs
  * Cache/KV eviction: 6 hrs
  * Archive/backup purging (best-effort accelerated path): 30 days with certified purge milestone at day 30 (customer can opt into paid expedited purge to 7 days)

- Rollback: we have a documented multi-step rollback playbook (detailed in the PDF) that includes staging a snapshot, validation tests, and an approval gate. Rollback during a true deletion window is time-sensitive: if deletion has completed on archival storage, rollback requires restoration from escrow/backup (which is possible but has a separate SLA and is billable as a data recovery engagement). For Dedicated/Private customers we can include one free on-demand rollback per year in the order form; additional restores are professional services.

Next steps I propose: review the attached playbook and pick which of the three deletion profiles (Standard / Accelerated / Locked-Short-Term) you want in the order form. Happy to jump on a quick call with your legal/security folks tomorrow.

Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Lead, Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood-bespoke-deletion-playbook-v1.pdf (PDF), orderform-retention-windows-diff.txt (plain text)

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Alex Nguyen <alex.nguyen@heliopharm.com>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, Sora Tech <security@soratech.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 13:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Questions on bespoke retention windows and deletion gating

Adding legal & ops perspective from our side — flagged items for Helio review: 

- Authoritative triggers: we need Helio to confirm which roles will be authorized to trigger/clear holds and provide a primary and secondary contact for escalation. We will not accept vague "security team" semantics in the order form.

- Certification wording: proposed language currently reads "Redwood will certify deletion where possible" — Helio should confirm whether they require an audit trail (we can provide a signed certificate + S3 deletion manifest) or a more formal attestation (e.g., notarized statement). The certificate is included by default for Dedicated/Private contracts; for Hosted we include a signed manifest.

- Escrow/restore costs: Marissa from Legal — rollback after final archive purge should be explicitly billable and called out as a separate line item. If you want dedicated short-term quarantines to allow faster restores, that can be added to the order form at a negotiated rate.

I've made inline suggestions in orderform-retention-windows-diff.txt (attached). If Helio wants the 7-day accelerated purge as a baseline, we need to move this to an enterprise addendum and adjust the pricing table.

Marissa Cole
Head of Contracts, Redwood Inference

From: Alex Nguyen <alex.nguyen@heliopharm.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, Sora Tech <security@soratech.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Questions on bespoke retention windows and deletion gating

Thanks all — this is helpful. Helio's security lead prefers: 

- Primary trigger: Helio Security Admin (name to follow), Secondary: Legal Ops.
- We want the 7-day accelerated purge option included as part of our Dedicated order form (will accept higher pricing).
- For rollback protections: include one complimentary restore-from-escrow per 12 months in the order form; additional restores billable. Please reflect that in the contract language and provide the certificate/manifest examples so our auditors can review.

If you can update the PDF and the order form diff with those two changes, we can do a final review next Tuesday. We can sign off after legal confirms the exact names for the roles.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Alex
